recognize_zh: 高倍下左側是淡粉紅、細顆粒狀的壞死區，右側交界處有大量深染的點狀核碎屑，混雜細胞質豐富、核淡染的組織球與少數漿細胞樣細胞；壞死邊緣的核碎屑與組織球反應，需鑑別菊池病、感染或狼瘡相關淋巴結炎。
features: Pale eosinophilic granular necrosis on one side of the field
Abundant dark karyorrhectic nuclear debris at the edge of necrosis
Histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei
Scattered plasmacytoid cells and small lymphocytes
Neutrophils and well-formed granulomas not evident in this field
describe_en: High-power view shows an area of pale eosinophilic granular necrosis bordered by abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris. The viable edge contains histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei, admixed with scattered plasmacytoid cells and small lymphocytes. Neutrophilic abscesses and well-formed epithelioid granulomas are not identified in this field. The findings represent a necrotizing lymphadenitis with histiocytic reaction; differential considerations include Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease, lupus lymphadenitis and infection, and special stains and cultures are recommended.

ddx.vs: Kikuchi disease shows similar karyorrhexis with crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells but characteristically lacks neutrophils and plasma cells are sparse.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial or fungal necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis
ddx.vs: Infectious granulomatous processes show palisading epithelioid histiocytes and giant cells around caseous necrosis, with organisms on AFB/GMS stains.
Lupus may show hematoxylin bodies and more plasma cells, and requires ANA/anti-dsDNA correlation.
